tasks.gr9-listening-speaking-t2: Topic: Prepared talks, interviews, summarising, group discussion, and role play. Cover preparation strategies, interview question formation, summary extraction, discussion participation, and role play engagement. Ask Grade 9 learners to evaluate prepared delivery, assess interview effectiveness, create accurate summaries, analyze discussion contributions, and reflect on role play performance.
tasks.gr9-reading-viewing-t2: Topic: Novel or folklore study, media texts, characterisation, message analysis, and visual literacy. Cover character development tracking, folklore significance, media persuasion techniques, message interpretation, and visual communication. Ask Grade 9 learners to trace character growth, identify cultural values in folklore, analyze media intent, determine unstated messages, and interpret visual symbolism.
tasks.gr9-writing-presenting-t2: Topic: Formal email, review, report, dialogue, and transactional writing. Cover email conventions, review structure with opinion, report organization, dialogue punctuation, and business writing register. Ask Grade 9 learners to compose professional emails, write balanced reviews, structure reports, format dialogue correctly, and maintain appropriate register throughout.
tasks.gr9-language-structures-t2: Topic: Connectors, passive voice, pronouns, question tags, and concord. Cover linking word functions, passive construction use, pronoun clarity, tag formation, and agreement patterns. Ask Grade 9 learners to use connectors purposefully, convert active to passive voice, ensure pronoun clarity, form question tags correctly, and apply concord rules consistently.
